subject: Alignment: Trial Orchestra — kickoff, acceptance gates & comms
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@orchestera.io>, James Patel <j.patel@orchestera.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Alignment: Trial Orchestra — kickoff, acceptance gates & comms

Thanks for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we have an operational lane into the trial: 

Key objectives (as discussed)
- Validate LLM-based response accuracy on Orchestra's customer support intents (top 20 intents).
- Meet latency SLO: 95th percentile < 450ms within trial traffic profile.
- Keep token cost below $0.0025 per 1k tokens for the evaluation workload.

Proposed success criteria (explicit metrics we can sign off on)
1) Intent-level F1 >= 0.82 on holdout test set (50k tickets sampled)
2) Latency: p95 < 450ms under steady-state 75rps workload
3) Error rate (model failures/timeout) < 0.3% over a 48h window
4) Integration: ability to call external tools (KB lookup) with structured responses

Timeline & milestones
- Pre-kickoff checklist: test dataset upload + SSO access (Engineering lead) — due Jun 4
- Kickoff call (product/eng): week of Jun 7 — propose Thu Jun 9 10:00 PT
- Weekly checkpoints: every Friday 10:00 PT (operational sync + metrics review)
- Final readout: Jun 30 (30 min executive readout + full metrics pack)

Owners (suggested)
- Redwood: Dylan (trial owner, success metrics), Marissa (CS lead, run check-ins), Karthik (security/compliance liaison)
- Orchestra: Sophie (product owner), James (eng lead)

Immediate asks for Orchestra
- Confirm kickoff date (we proposed Jun 9)
- Share who will own test dataset transfer and whether SFTP or S3/Presigned URLs work
- Provide SSO/SCIM admin contact if you want SSO preconfigured

I attached a short success-metrics workbook and a mutual action plan (MAP) that maps these milestones to dates/owners. Once we align on kickoff and dataset transfer method, I’ll create the calendar invites and the weekly agenda template.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

—
Dylan Brooks
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai | +1-415-555-0124

Attachments: trial-orchestra-success-metrics.xlsx (workbook), mutual-action-plan.docx (MAP)

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@orchestera.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: James Patel <j.patel@orchestera.io>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 16:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: Trial Orchestra — kickoff, acceptance gates & comms

Thanks Dylan — this looks good and aligns with our needs. A couple of quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Security/compliance: we will need the redacted SOC2 evidence and a short summary of data retention practices before kickoff. Can Karthik or Marissa share these?
2) Dataset: we prefer S3 presigned URLs for the initial transfer; James will coordinate.
3) Kickoff: Jun 9 could work, though Jun 8 might be marginally better for our Eng schedule. Can you do Jun 8 at the same time?

We're excited to see how Redwood performs on our high-calendar-volume sample. If acceptable, I'll send calendar availability for Jun 8/9 once I sync with James.

Best,
Sophie Turner
Head of Product, Orchestra Inc.
sophie.turner@orchestera.io | +1-617-555-3399

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@orchestera.io>, James Patel <j.patel@orchestera.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: Trial Orchestra — kickoff, acceptance gates & comms

Appreciate the fast turnaround, Sophie. Jun 8 at 10:00 PT works on our side — I’ll tentatively hold that slot. 

Regarding security/compliance: Karthik — can you drop a redacted SOC2 summary and the short data-retention statement (1 pager) into the Drive link below? I’m including the redacted SOC2 summary we can share; see attached PDF.

On acceptance criteria — small refinement based on our runtime constraints: the p95 latency threshold is measured with the KV cache enabled and during a sustained 75rps run for 30 minutes. We’ll capture both cold-start p95 and warmed p95 in the trial metrics pack.

Next steps (we’ll action immediately):
- James: provide S3 presigned path + sample file layout by Jun 4
- Orchestra: assign an eng point-of-contact for SSO/scoping if you want us to preconfigure
- Redwood: I’ll create the MAP in HubSpot and share weekly agenda template + invite once we lock kickoff.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XA_trial_onramp_MAP
HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2027-ORC-091

—
Dylan

Attachments: redacted-SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Orchestra trial owners, check-ins & readout lead

Dropping in a quick internal note so we land owners and the meeting cadence before the external kickoff.

Proposed internal roster
- Trial lead (customer-facing, weekly agenda): Marissa Cole (CS Lead)
- Technical integrator: Dylan Brooks (handles dataset/endpoint wiring)
- Security/compliance liaison: Karthik Iyer (SOC2/retention)
- Escalation contact: Rajiv (Support, contact via shared PagerDuty)

Meeting cadence
- Pre-kickoff technical runthrough: Jun 4 11:00 PT (30m) — verify dataset layout + presigned URL access
- Kickoff (external): Jun 8 10:00 PT (60m) — playbook + roles + clarifying Qs
- Weekly checkpoints: Fridays 10:00 PT (30m) — metrics, blockers, next steps
- Final readout dry-run (internal): Jun 28 09:00 PT (30m)
- Final readout (external): Jun 30 11:00 PT (30m)

Notes: I’ll own the weekly agenda and the executive slide deck for the final readout. Dylan — can you confirm you can run the pre-kickoff on Jun 4? Karthik, please confirm the SOC2 artifact path we plan to share (redacted).

Marissa
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@orchestera.io>, James Patel <j.patel@orchestera.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Alignment: Trial Orchestra — kickoff, acceptance gates & comms

All — quick operational confirmation ahead of next week: we've locked the kickoff for Jun 8 at 10:00 PT (invite sent). Weekly checkpoints will be Fridays at 10:00 PT, and the executive readout is scheduled for Jun 30 at 11:00 PT.

Sophie/Jamess — thanks for the S3 presigned link (received and validated). James — your sample layout looked good; we ingested a 10k-sample locally for the pre-kickoff runthrough. 

Security artifacts: Karthik attached a redacted SOC2 summary in the MAP Drive folder. Data retention statement is included as a one-pager in the same folder.

Pre-kickoff (Jun 4 11:00 PT) notes: we validated S3 connectivity, verified file schema, and confirmed tokenization/encoding choices. No blockers from our side.

Next steps for Orchestra before kickoff
- Confirm the eng attendee list for Jun 8
- Share any additional test scenarios you want in the first week (e.g., KB lookup edge-cases)

Map & invites: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-2027-ORC-091 | https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XA_trial_onramp_MAP

Looking forward — see you on Jun 8.

—
Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
